answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded escrows and evidence linking coordinated identities: if k identities equivocate on the same kernel, pairwise correlated penalties grow as k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than as isolated per-identity fines. On detection, slashing and asymmetric depreciation compound across the swarm, making total capital loss rise by an exponential multiplier with its size. The onyx ledger records the links; a canyon of nominal identities cannot shield shared control or collateral.
